Name: Stardew Content Studio
Author: Hashiru777
Description:
Make your own Stardew content from your own images, right in the game. Press K to open the editor.
NEW IN 0.5.0
- Mining & Museum, a new mod. Your own minerals, gems and artefacts: their picture, what they are, what they sell for, their colour, which of the six geodes give them and how often, where artefact spots dig them up, whether the museum takes them, and which villagers love or hate them as gifts.
- And rocks of your own, which turn up in place of the game's: in the mines, Skull Cavern, the Quarry Mine, the volcano on Ginger Island, and above ground on the farm, in the forest, on the mountain and in its quarry, the backwoods, town and more, in the seasons you pick. Set how many hits they take, the mining experience they give, and what they give when broken - your own minerals, the game's, or ores.
- The game's own minerals and rocks get the same Game tab as everywhere else: new art, hold one back so it stops turning up, or make your own copy to start from.
- Chances are typed now instead of picked from a short list, so 12.5% is as easy as 10%: geodes, artefact spots, where rocks turn up and what they drop, a painting's chance while fishing, and a paint layer's opacity.
- Fix: the museum's donation screen wouldn't close while you were holding something, so once the museum was full - which your own minerals make likely - you were stuck. It lets you out now and hands the item back.
NEW IN 0.4.3
- Fix: typing a K into a name closed the editor. It's ignored while you type now, and a red X in the corner closes the editor.
- Paint: layers, as a tool with its own column (key N): new, copy, move, hide, show at 75/50/25%, merge.
- Crops: which villagers love or hate them as gifts, a colour for dyes, honey and wine, and paint the seed packet itself.
- Every Game tab: make your own copy of a game crop, piece of furniture, wallpaper, painting or fish, to change as you like.
NEW IN 0.4.0
- Fish, a new mod. Your own fish: its picture (from an image or painted in the game), where and when it bites (fifteen places from the town river to the volcano, seasons, weather, hours), caught with a rod (difficulty, how it moves in the minigame, size, fishing level) or in crab pots, how it swims in fish tanks, whether it lives in fish ponds and the colour of its roe, and which villagers love or hate it as a gift. The game's own fish can get new art for the item and the tank, stop biting anywhere, or be copied as a starting point for your own.
- Themes & backups. A theme is a whole set of your content, so one game can hold several projects and switch between them in a click. Backups (made before joining a host's game, before an import, and of deleted themes) and exported packs are listed beside them and open as new themes, so importing never overwrites anything.
- Paint: zoom as far as you like, start strokes, shapes and selections off the edge of the image (only the part on it counts), and the brush is centred on the cursor, so a big brush reaches the edges from outside.
- The start page lays the sections out in two columns when there are more than five, and shows the theme in use.
WHAT'S INCLUDED (seven mods in one download)
- Content Studio: Core (required): the in-game editor and pixel editor, a file browser to pick images from your computer, image cropping, HD drawing, themes and backups, content packs, earlier versions, and optional multiplayer.
- Content Studio: Paintings: add your own paintings (PNG/JPEG), replace or hide the game's paintings, standing photo frames, slideshows with captions (they can also animate), a full-screen viewer, frames, prices, and where to get them (shops, fishing, including Ginger Island).
- Content Studio: Characters: villager portraits (one image for every emotion, with per-emotion overrides) and villager sprites in HD, plus HD sheets for the farmer's body, hair, beards and glasses, and for shirts, pants and hats. Your farmer's skin, eye, shoe and clothing colours still work.
- Content Studio: Crops: your own crops with seeds, growth stages and harvest, sold at Pierre, JojaMart or the traveling cart. Paint the growing plant instead of importing a sheet. New art for the game's crops, or take their seeds out of the shops.
- Content Studio: Furniture: furniture based on a game piece: lamps that switch on at night, fireplaces, beds, animated decor, tables and more. Also wallpaper and floor tiles from your images. New art for the game's furniture and wallpaper, or take them out of the shops.
- Content Studio: Fish: your own fish - where and when they bite, rod or crab pot, fish tanks, ponds and gifts. New art for the game's fish, or stop one biting.
- Content Studio: Mining & Museum: see above.
Only install the mods you want, but Content Studio: Core is always needed. The banner's "one Emily per mod" (the wallpaper, painting, bed, fish, the plants in the pots, and Emily with her own flower) was all made with these mods from the game's own Emily art.
INSTALLATION
1. Install SMAPI.
2. Unzip into your Stardew Valley Mods folder (you get a folder per mod).
3. Start the game through SMAPI and press K.
MULTIPLAYER
Everything here is off unless you turn it on, on one Multiplayer screen, and you should only play this way with people you trust. The host turns on "Share my content when I host"; each player turns on "Accept shared content". While you are in that game you use the host's set, and your own is kept in a backup and put back when you leave. Adding something of your own, and changing what you added, is always yours to do; the host's own items, and changes to the game's own items, open up only if the host also turns on "Let players change my content". Everything a player sends is checked and rebuilt before the host writes it, and the version it replaces is kept.
STATUS (please read)
- Tested by hand on Linux only, with Stardew Valley 1.6.15 and SMAPI 4.5.2. Windows and macOS have not been tested yet; the code was reviewed for OS differences, but a review isn't a test. Reports are very welcome.
- Multiplayer was tested over LAN/direct IP with up to four players, not Steam/GOG invites.
- Fish: catching was checked in the town and forest rivers, fish tanks, ponds (accepted, roe colour) and gifts; the other places, crab pots overnight and pond roe over several days are not tested yet. Custom fish don't bite on mine floors 80-119, where the game uses its own list.
- Mining: geodes, artefact spots, the museum (including a full one), rocks in the mines, the Quarry Mine and the volcano, breaking them with a pickaxe, rocks turning up above ground by season, and two players in a shared game were all checked in game.
- Not tested together with other mods that change the same things (portrait/sprite mods, farmer clothing mods, Content Patcher packs for furniture, crops or fish).
- Deleting a custom item in the editor turns copies already placed in your save into Error Items (the editor warns you). Switching themes does the same for the old theme's things while the other one is in use.
- This is an early version. Back up your saves.
Bug reports, feedback and feature requests: https://github.com/DonateIfYouCan/stardew-content-studio/issues
Full test coverage and compatibility notes, and the source code (MIT licence): https://github.com/DonateIfYouCan/stardew-content-studio
This mod is not related to Platonymous' Custom Furniture; it shares no code with it. The mods were renamed from "Custom ..." to "Content Studio: ..." to avoid confusion.
Thanks for using these mods! They're free, and every feature works without donating. If you'd like to: https://buymeacoffee.com/donateifyoucan
